environment.description: Quarkus 2.16 native image deployed as a Knative serving revision on GKE Autopilot. Pod spec includes securityContext with drop: [ALL] and add: [NET_BIND_SERVICE] only. The cluster enforces a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-sysctls-and-caps' that mutates all pod specs to ensure capabilities are dropped. Additionally, the GKE node pool runs with COS_CONTAINERD image and has metadata-concealment enabled. The Istio sidecar (injected via mesh membership) applies a Sidecar resource scoping egress to only *.cluster.local hosts, and a NetworkPolicy of type Egress restricts pod communication to the cluster DNS (kube-dns on port 53/UDP) and the internal invoice-db service on port 5432. No egress to external IPs or hostnames is permitted at the CNI level (Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy with deny-all-egress-except-allowed). The container image is built with -Dquarkus.native.additional-build-args=--initialize-at-build-time and runs as non-root UID 1001.
